_note: Seed split, adopted 2026-09-21 after external research showed this project had been tuning and evaluating on the same single-run data (docs/MEASUREMENTS.md, protocol). CALIBRATION_SEEDS may be re-run freely while picking thresholds. TEST_SEEDS is LOCKED: run it once, at the end, report that number as the result, and never re-run it after changing anything. If you look at it twice it stops being a test set.
note_on_test_seeds: Chosen as a contiguous block disjoint from calibration, and fixed before any run. Do not substitute seeds after seeing results.
